explanation: The chain correctly orders the photos and adds the exact titles, but it never explicitly discards the animation model’s generated audio before adding music; saying “no speech” is not a reliable audio-replacement instruction. The animation prompts also leave zoom magnitude and mixed-aspect framing underspecified, allowing the latte shot to become too tightly cropped.
better_chain: image-to-video (each supplied photo; tiny, bounded camera movement, preserve identifying details, fit without stretching or aggressive cropping) → music (9-second soft upbeat instrumental, no vocals) → assemble (first 3 seconds of each clip, storefront first; fit proportionally in 9:16; discard all source-clip audio and use only the music; total 9 seconds) → text-overlay (Maple Street Café, 0–3 seconds) → text-overlay (Your morning starts here, 6–9 seconds) → gate (verify no speech, gentle movement, preserved photo details, framing, titles and duration)
